taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: OWASP LLM01:2025; web Top 10 lens is optional planning compatibility only

controls.boundary: LLM application instruction and data boundary — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Identify attacker-controlled content sources, instruction boundaries, model/task configuration and actual downstream capabilities. Define a measurable protected task or authority invariant.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned local fixture insert a benign conflicting instruction into a retrieved page/document. Compare an uncontaminated task with the contaminated one and inspect structured output/tool records for the defined violation. Use synthetic canaries and inert tool effects, not real secret extraction.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: The model quoting hostile text is not necessarily following it. A changed answer without a protected task violation is a narrower observation. Prompt wording and a single successful refusal do not prove robust enforcement.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain external-content authority and enforce sensitive tool/data actions outside model interpretation. Retest the original source/channel and legitimate document tasks; describe residual model variability honestly.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
